title: Centred valuation
statement: For a scheme Z, a point η, a valuation subring V of the residue field of η, and a morphism v : Spec V → Z, v is a centred valuation at η when v composed with the canonical map Spec κ(η) → Spec V is the canonical morphism Spec κ(η) → Z. Here schemes and affine spectra use [def-pc-scheme] and [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the generic point uses [def-sc-generic-point], the residue field uses [def-weil-residue-field], and the field condition uses [def-weil-field].

source.place: Temkin §3.2, definition of Val_K(S) preceding Corollary 3.2.5, p. 16
